correctness.rationale: The specialized implicit update is solved as an exact orthogonal Cayley rotation of a full momentum kick. Independent Gaussian kicks give an explicit rank-one conjugation sum, which is evaluated using double angles and a finite geometric series. The traceless eigenvalue splitting proves the complete isotropy classification for every integer N and all h>0. The exact stochastic convolution determines C(T). Expanding the modified rotation frequency and right-endpoint quadrature proves the O(h) coefficient; when omega*T is an integer multiple of pi, the first two quadrature boundary differences vanish and the frequency shift gives the nonzero sigma² omega² T/24 diagonal tensor. The mean differs by O(h²), yielding weak O(h²) for polynomial degree <=2. The fixed-N large-h limit follows by R_theta -> -I and oscillatory exact covariance averaging. The included exact-rational checker tests 1042 finite assertions and approximate limiting witnesses; analyticity, not finite enumeration, establishes the universal claims.

value.rationale: A published energy-drift-preserving integrator is a natural benchmark in stochastic Hamiltonian numerical analysis. Exact energy preservation only controls covariance trace and misses substantial directional miscalibration. The theorem determines the complete phase-locked finite-step isotropy set, identifies precisely the terminal times for a genuine weak-order recovery and its sharp coefficient, and quantifies the extreme-stepsize anisotropy by a normalized norm limit of 1/2. These are structurally motivated accuracy boundaries, not arbitrary table entries or a routine renaming. Scope remains a single harmonic mode and quadratic observables, with no claim of a generally improved integrator.
